title: atlas.assertion.propose.v1 — arguments
description: Commit one or more assertions under a single idempotency key. The submission is all-or-nothing: one submission is one durable commit group. A retry with the same (client_id, idempotency_key) returns the ORIGINAL receipt with the ORIGINAL ids; the same key with a different payload is a typed conflict, never a silent accept of either version.

idempotency_key.description: Identity is (client_id, idempotency_key) and never a content hash: an assertion's body carries a server-assigned recorded_at, so the same logical write can never hash the same twice. Content-addressed identity and server-assigned belief time are mutually exclusive, and belief time wins.

expected_feed_epoch.description: Refuse the commit if the epoch has rolled since you last read. Optional; supply it when superseding.
